responsibility: Provides the public ACLE header for Armv8-M Security Extensions (CMSE). It defines the cmse_address_info_t bitfield layout, inline TT/TTA/TTT/TTAT query intrinsics, nonsecure-caller and nonsecure-function-pointer helpers, permission flag macros, and checked-address helpers used by secure firmware and gateway code to reason about secure/nonsecure memory accessibility and call provenance.
